reaction_overview: The dataset pertains to the catalytic dehydrogenation of propane (C3H8) to produce propylene (C3H6), a key intermediate in the production of various petrochemicals and polymers. This reaction is industrially significant as it enhances the yield of propylene, a critical feedstock for the production of plastics, fibers, and other chemical products, thereby optimizing resource utilization in the petrochemical industry.
